title: Precise length and charge segmentation of billion-dalton supramolecular polymers
title_zh: 精准长度与电荷分段的十亿道尔顿超分子聚合物
abstract: Supramolecular polymers with precise micrometer-scale segments of opposite charge are challenging to synthesize as discrete assemblies in water. These systems could be used to pattern charged surfaces, interact with the membranes of cells, or form hierarchical structures. We report a living polymerization of fibrillar peptide assemblies with a central positively charged segment flanked by negative ones that can have a collective molar mass on the order of billions of daltons. The self-capping supramolecular polymerization required an untwisted β sheet core persisting along the entire length of the assembly as well as dormant ends in the absence of a monomer source. The positive domains of the segmented structures were anchored to the membranes of neurons, leaving the connected negative segments in a highly dynamic state near the cells through charge repulsion. The segmented architecture generated extensive neurite growth and synaptic activity.
abstract_zh: 具有精确微米级相反电荷分段的超分子聚合物在水中作为离散组装体合成具有挑战性。这些系统可用于模式化带电表面、与细胞膜相互作用或形成层级结构。我们报道了一种纤维状肽组装体的活性聚合，中心为正电荷段，两侧为负电荷段，整体摩尔质量可达十亿道尔顿。自封闭的超分子聚合需要整个组装长度上持续存在的未扭曲β折叠核心以及在无单体源时的休眠端点。分段结构的正电域被锚定在神经元膜上，负电段通过电荷排斥保持在细胞附近的高度动态状态。该分段架构促进了广泛的神经突起生长和突触活动。
